project_ideas.hypothesis: An identity-aware credential-injecting proxy in front of HTTP/SQL tools can be induced to execute a call with a higher privilege than the initiating caller's identity in at least one of three patterns: replayed session binding, nested tool call inheriting the prior caller, or scope-confusion in a mediated call whose target is attacker-influenced.
project_ideas.measurement: Number of adversarial traces producing a successful high-privilege call, classified by pattern, and the minimum proxy hardening change that drives each pattern to zero.
project_ideas.name: Confused-Deputy Injection Proxy Red Team
project_ideas.poc: Stand up a minimal injection proxy that resolves credentials per call from a caller identity token, wrap a mock high-privilege data API behind it, and run a suite of adversarial agent traces (prompt-injected nested calls, session-replay, target-rewrite) against it.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Agents should not auto-add memory or wiki pages without human confirmation
project_ideas.hypothesis: At sustained volume above roughly 100 agent-proposed memory additions per day, human confirmation of scoped wiki additions degrades measurably — reviewer dwell time collapses and the unreviewed-or-auto-approved merge fraction rises — even though the pipeline's stated design requires genuine confirmation.
project_ideas.measurement: Median review dwell time, edits-per-merge, rejection rate, and the slope of auto-approval as a function of daily proposal volume; flag the volume at which dwell time drops below a threshold indicating nominal review.
project_ideas.name: Review-at-Scale Memory Pipeline
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a propose-scope-confirm-merge pipeline with synthetic but realistic agent suggestions at 10, 50, 150 and 300 additions/day, recording dwell time, edit-before-merge rate, and rejection rate per volume tier.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Wiki contributions per day increasing steadily from 0 to over 300 updates per day over a two-month period
project_ideas.hypothesis: Rising daily wiki update volume is a noisy proxy for brain health: above some threshold, marginal updates correlate with duplication and contradiction in the context store and with flat or declining agent task success, not with improved success.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between weekly update volume and agent task success rate, plus duplication and contradiction density in the store; report whether success improves, plateaus, or degrades past a volume inflection.
project_ideas.name: Update-Rate vs. Task-Outcome Study
project_ideas.poc: Run a longitudinal instrumented deployment (or a simulated one seeded with the reported 0-to-300+ updates/day trajectory) that logs update rate alongside context-store duplication/contradiction metrics and a fixed agent task suite's success and error rates.
project_ideas.video_title: Your company brain will leak secrets: how we stopped it for big banks — Tanmai Gopal, PromptQL

project_ideas.based_on: Running an LLM agent is fundamentally a search problem
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed agent task, improving context placement and retrieval tooling yields at least a 30% relative task-success improvement equal to or greater than spending the same engineering budget on prompt engineering.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, context-window fill efficiency, and latency/cost per engineering-hour invested.
project_ideas.name: Context Placement Harness
project_ideas.poc: Build a benchmark around a tool-using agent, comparing variants with (a) sophisticated retrieval/index/context selectors and (b) prompt refinements; keep the underlying model constant and track expected engineering hours.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: returns a relationship strength score without exposing raw conversation content
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent using a relationship-strength score API can answer referral/interaction questions within 5 percentage points of an agent with raw corporate email access, while exposing zero raw email content to the model.
project_ideas.measurement: Task accuracy, number/size of raw content leaks sent to the model, and user trust/explanation quality.
project_ideas.name: Signal-Score Cross-Silo API
project_ideas.poc: Create a synthetic email corpus and a cross-silo tool that computes a relationship score per pair; run two agents side-by-side: one with the signal API and one with raw corpus search.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: low-sensitivity zones
project_ideas.hypothesis: A policy engine that automatically classifies agent actions into low-sensitivity/low-risk zones can reduce manual approval load by at least 80% without increasing policy-violation rate beyond an allowed audit threshold.
project_ideas.measurement: Manual review reduction, false-approval/violation rate, escalation rate in higher-sensitivity zones.
project_ideas.name: Sensitivity-Zone Auto-Approval Engine
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a development-workflow agent to request permission gates; train/use a classifier on action metadata and PII/data-sensitivity indicators; run in shadow mode against human approvals for N=2,000 actions.
project_ideas.video_title: Agents' next frontier: agent-to-agent and network effects — Jean-Denis Greze, Town

project_ideas.based_on: AI has changed the startup landscape by introducing massive GPU and token costs.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Exposing per-step inference cost in an agent orchestration layer and routing easy intents through cheap models reduces cost per successful task by at least 30% without lowering pass rate on a fixed evaluation set.
project_ideas.measurement: Cost per successful task on a fixed set of 500 tasks; success rate; p50 and p95 latency before and after routing.
project_ideas.name: Cost-First Orchestration with a Token Ledger
project_ideas.poc: Build a proxy around an existing agent that logs tokens consumed at every step and inserts a fast intent classifier to send easy tasks to a small model while complex tasks continue to the frontier model.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: Early AI models felt like an undergraduate struggling through a paper, but capabilities have evolved rapidly.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent whose control logic is isolated behind a model abstraction layer will show less than 5% behavioral regression after swapping to a newer model generation, while the same workflow with model-specific prompt patches will regress more than 20%.
project_ideas.measurement: Behavioral pass rate before and after model substitution; number of workflow failures; lines of code changed to accommodate the new model.
project_ideas.name: Model-Swap Regression Suite
project_ideas.poc: Implement a common document-extraction workflow twice: once with a version-agnostic model interface and once with direct model calls and instance-specific workarounds. Run both against two consecutive model versions.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: Technology often starts by imitating simple narrow functions (like a fly's brain) and scales up to complex human capabilities
project_ideas.hypothesis: A customer-support assistant deployed first as narrow perfect intent handlers will show a lower high-severity failure rate in its first month than the same broad assistant launched with a general prompt and full tool access on day one.
project_ideas.measurement: High-severity failure rate per 100 completed tasks; rate of human-like plausible-but-wrong outputs; cost per successful task.
project_ideas.name: Fly-to-Human Staged Deployment Harness
project_ideas.poc: Create two variants of an internal triage agent. Variant A has one broad prompt with unrestricted tools; variant B uses a deterministic router to fixed narrow handlers. Run both on identical task queues and record failures.
project_ideas.video_title: Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders

project_ideas.based_on: The first 15 to 17 years of a founder's life shape their character and resilience.
project_ideas.hypothesis: If two agent models are matched on current benchmark performance, the model whose history includes documented adversarial fine-tuning and recovery traces will have at least a 20% lower failure rate on novel task disruptions than the model without such history.
project_ideas.measurement: Failure-rate delta on a shifted-task suite at equivalent baseline performance.
project_ideas.name: Provenance-Card Evaluator
project_ideas.poc: Take an open-weights base model; produce model A with standard SFT and model B with SFT plus adversarial stress-tuning and self-recovery record; select checkpoints so that baseline benchmarks match; run both on held-out shifted tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Google was perceived as a late entry into search.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent built behind a model-agnostic internal API can swap from an incumbent model to a late-entrant model in under one working day and improve task success by at least 15% without any changes to planning or tool logic.
project_ideas.measurement: Swap lead time in hours and percent task-success improvement on an agentic benchmark.
project_ideas.name: Late-Entrant Adapter Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Implement a minimal agent with internal API and adapter; run on incumbent model A; swap to late-entrant model B using the same adapter; run the same agentic task suite before and after the swap.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Webvan was a colossal mistake where Sequoia lost 44 million dollars.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Gating scale-out on infrastructure-readiness thresholds (e.g., cost per successful task below a threshold, tool success rate above a threshold, observability coverage above a threshold) reduces cumulative capital wasted by at least 30% compared with un-gated rollout.
project_ideas.measurement: Wasted compute dollars; cumulative loss; time to positive unit economics in gated vs un-gated modes.
project_ideas.name: Readiness-Gated Agent Spend
project_ideas.poc: Build a lightweight middleware gate that blocks concurrency increases when readiness metadata is below threshold; simulate gated vs un-gated rollouts on the same task mix under synthetic infrastructure-maturity curves.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Bad decisions come from imperfect data, overcomplicating things, and failing to do proper homework.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An evaluation harness that pre-checks dataset contamination, duplicate examples, and label ambiguity surfaces as many defect classes as a complex multi-stage orchestration while reducing mean time-to-debug by at least 50%.
project_ideas.measurement: Defect-detection recall and mean time-to-debug in each harness.
project_ideas.name: Data-Quality-First Eval Harness
project_ideas.poc: Run the same set of deliberately defective agent tasks through (a) a linear data-quality-gated harness and (b) a multi-step orchestrated harness; compare defect discoveries and debugging traces.
project_ideas.video_title: Former Sequoia Chairman Michael Moritz on Founders: "It's About the First 15 or 16 Years of Life"

project_ideas.based_on: Even having a mobile phone visible in a room creates subconscious cognitive load and reduces focus capacity.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Holding token count constant, removing unused high-salience tool notifications from the active reasoning context before a difficult task improves task accuracy by at least 10% compared to leaving them in contex.
project_ideas.measurement: Task accuracy, attention entropy over active tokens, and number of redundant tool calls before task completion.
project_ideas.name: Context-Room Eviction: Invisible Phone Benchmark
project_ideas.poc: Build a controlled benchmark pair from a hard long-horizon reasoning task; in the treatment, stale tool outputs and system reminders are moved out of the active context into an external index, while baseline keeps them in-context; both have the same non-distractor token budget.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Side sleeping enhances glymphatic clearance of metabolic waste products from the brain.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agents that consolidate state during an explicit offline stage after each session retain at least 15% more key facts after 100 turns than agents that compress only when the token limit is reached.
project_ideas.measurement: Fact recall accuracy, contamination or stale-artifact reuse rate, and peak active context length.
project_ideas.name: Sleep-Compactor for Multi-Session Memory
project_ideas.poc: Implement a memory subsystem with an end-of-cycle hook; run a long-horizon benchmark with two arms: one performs 'sleep' compaction (prune low-signal, promote high-value memories) and one no-ops until forced token-limit truncation; compare downstream fact recall.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Physiological sighs immediately offload carbon dioxide and slow heart rate.
project_ideas.hypothesis: On unexpected agent errors, invoking a minimal context rollback and retry before starting diagnostic reasoning reduces recovery failure loops by at least 20% compared with starting full diagnostics immediately.
project_ideas.measurement: Recovery success rate, mean steps to successful recovery, and error-trace length consumed before the final solution.
project_ideas.name: Sigh-Reset Error Handler for Agents
project_ideas.poc: Instrument an agentic coding framework with a deterministic error injection suite; baseline path runs deep trace analysis on the current disturbed context; treatment path executes a rehearsed reset primitive that truncates the noisy recent context and retries once before deep analysis.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Cardio and resistance training prime the brain for optimal learning and neuroplasticity in the subsequent hours.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Inserting a deliberately hard, low-stakes warmup task immediately before a learning block outperforms dependency-only task ordering, yielding at least 10% better performance on downstream held-out tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Downstream task accuracy, learning curve area, and computational steps or prompts used.
project_ideas.name: Morning-Prime Warmup for Ordered Learning
project_ideas.poc: Implement a task pipeline with two scheduling conditions: standard dependency-based order and a 'primed' order that runs a high-effort activation task just before the encoding/learning segment; compare on a few-shot benchmark with held-out tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Andrew Huberman: My Exact Routine To Optimize Brain & Body, I Do All Of These Every Day!

project_ideas.based_on: Ablates misaligned features during training and fine-tuning to prevent emergent misalignment.
project_ideas.hypothesis: When an LLM is fine-tuned on a narrow, potentially misaligning corpus, ablating the detected misaligned concept during fine-tuning yields a lower external safety-eval misalignment rate than standard fine-tuning.
project_ideas.measurement: Safety eval score on a held-out adversarial set; target concept removal fidelity; code task accuracy delta.
project_ideas.name: CAFT-Guard: Fine-tuning gate with concept ablation
project_ideas.poc: Fine-tune two identical models on an insecure-code corpus: one baseline and one with an SAE-identified misaligned feature ablated per training step; compare downstream safety evaluations and code utility scores.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Using interpretability features as reward signals to supervise open-ended tasks and reduce hallucinations.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a sparse-autoencoder-derived truthfulness feature as a reward signal to an RL fine-tuning loop reduces hallucination on held-out prompts compared with an identical loop using only a task reward.
project_ideas.measurement: Hallucination rate on unseen generation tasks; reward hacking frequency measured by probe divergence from initial feature geometry.
project_ideas.name: FeatureReward: Using SAE probes in RL fine-tuning
project_ideas.poc: Fine-tune a small generative model on a public QA task; train an SAE on layer activations; define a probe reward based on the truthfulness feature; report RL comparison with and without probe reward.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Concepts inside neural networks are organized into geometric structures or manifolds rather than flat, unstructured spaces.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Steering an LLM along a concept manifold direction produces significantly larger intended semantic shifts than an equal-norm random activation direction, while keeping perplexity within a bounded margin of baseline.
project_ideas.measurement: Semantic classifier agreement difference between steered and unsteered outputs; perplexity difference; cosine distance from original prompt embedding.
project_ideas.name: ManifoldPilot: Activation-space steering interface
project_ideas.poc: Train an SAE on a 7B model, locate day-of-week or formality manifold directions, and expose an endpoint that adds the direction vector to layer activations at generation time in head-to-head tests vs prompt-only steering.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: We should be able to speedrun science once we have agents that can do experimental work.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An LLM-driven agent can discover a known geometric feature (e.g., day-of-week direction) in a transformer using autonomously generated hypothesis-intervention-measure loops with fewer trials than random search over activation directions.
project_ideas.measurement: Time-to-discovery, number of steering interventions, success rate against ground-truth SAE direction, and agent report quality.
project_ideas.name: AutoInterp: Agentic speedrun harness for feature discovery
project_ideas.poc: Build a harness exposing activation sampling, random direction steering, and classification-based outcome metrics to an agent; instruct it to find a direction that shifts day-of-week classification; run repeated trials on a small open-weight transformer.
project_ideas.video_title: Strange Geometric Shapes Found Inside AIs — Tom McGrath

project_ideas.based_on: Claude 5 models perform best when given the complete task specification upfront.
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed set of long-horizon tasks, one-shot whole-job prompting achieves at least equal objective task success while consuming fewer interaction tokens and user turns than step-by-step decomposition prompting.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate per condition, tokens per successful task, user edit/correction count.
project_ideas.name: SpecBench
project_ideas.poc: Build a task suite from real-world long-horizon jobs; run each condition on the same model; score outputs against objective criteria automatically and log token/metadata.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Investing time in pre-planning saves tokens and prevents endless iteration cycles.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A harness that triggers an interview phase only when model-predicted task ambiguity exceeds a threshold will reduce total user interaction time and token spend compared to both no-interview and always-interview policies.
project_ideas.measurement: Mean time-to-completion, retries per task, user satisfaction score, tokens consumed.
project_ideas.name: AmbiguityRouter
project_ideas.poc: Build a thin orchestrator in front of a long-horizon model: it asks the model to score ambiguity, then conditionally emits clarifying questions before generating the full task spec.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Defining exact exit criteria prevents token burning.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Injecting machine-checkable exit criteria derived from the user's 'done means' into the system prompt will reduce token overspend from over-delivery without reducing user-rated completion quality.
project_ideas.measurement: Token consumption per run, overrun rate (work beyond done), user-rated quality score.
project_ideas.name: DoneShield
project_ideas.poc: In an agent loop, parse the task spec for explicit exit predicates, expose them to the model and to a scheduler that checks for early stopping, then compare against a baseline with no exit guard.
project_ideas.video_title: Anthropic Just Revealed 7 New Rules for Prompting Claude 5 Models

project_ideas.based_on: Users need to be able to inspect assumptions, intermediate calculations, and source provenance easily.
project_ideas.hypothesis: When users are shown an AI data answer with assumption breakdown, intermediate calculations, and a notebook link, time-to-verification and correct acceptance rate improves by at least 50% over a zero-context answer-only UI.
project_ideas.measurement: Time-to-verification (seconds), correct acceptance rate, false-acceptance rate, and number of user clicks on source artifacts.
project_ideas.name: VeriTracer: notebook-dossier answers for data agents
project_ideas.poc: Enhance a simple Q/A data agent to emit a Runme-compatible notebook (assumptions, steps, source links) as its output; A/B test with domain analysts on real business questions.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Transition failure matrices showing state-to-state failures in agent workflows.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Recording agent state-to-state transitions and computing a failure matrix will surface the highest-frequency failure transition with 3x fewer logs examined than random manual trace search.
project_ideas.measurement: Precision/recall of detected hotspot transition vs. ground-truth from manual log review; reduction in failure rate after focused fix.
project_ideas.name: AgentFailMapper
project_ideas.poc: Build a thin tracing layer around an agent framework (e.g., LangGraph) that logs states/transitions, aggregates failure rates into matrices, and produces ranked hotspot lists.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Active learning by surfacing low-confidence examples to human annotators.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Low-confidence surfacing of agent traces will identify novel error categories at least 1.5x faster per annotation hour than random sampling during initial eval-set construction.
project_ideas.measurement: Novel error categories discovered per hour, annotation time, learner accuracy before/after labels, error coverage.
project_ideas.name: EvalLens Active-learning sampler
project_ideas.poc: Implement a small tool that scores raw agent traces by confidence, selects top-N for human review, and periodically feeds findings into a structured eval set; run on a realistic batch of traces.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: WebMCP allows browser-based applications to expose tools directly to AI agents without server backends.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A WebMCP browser-native tool exposure for a standard app can match a server-backend API on task success rate while cutting integration boilerplate in half, though with an additional measurable per-action failure rate due to browser context.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate, lines of integration code/time, per-action failure rate, and browser-layer exception rate.
project_ideas.name: Browser-API parity testbed for WebMCP
project_ideas.poc: Stand up one common web app (e.g., a collaborative spreadsheet UI) and create two tool endpoints (WebMCP and HTTP server API). Run same set of agent tasks against both and compare.
project_ideas.video_title: Stop Shipping AI Nobody Can Verify with Hamel Husain

project_ideas.based_on: Four different prototype iterations of a sales report query yielding inconsistent timeframes, data formats, and layouts.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Repeated identical natural-language queries rendered through a slot-constrained declarative pipeline produce measurably lower layout/semantic variance than the same queries rendered through an unconstrained LLM-to-JSON pipeline.
project_ideas.measurement: Normalized structural edit distance between rendered layouts, semantic field agreement for timeframes/data formats, and invalid-component rate per mode.
project_ideas.name: LayoutDrift: A reproducibility harness for intent-driven interfaces
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a dashboard generator that renders the same KPI request N times under two modes: unconstrained LLM dashboard generation vs. generation constrained by a slot/sub-slot skeleton and component catalog; compare the resulting component trees and datasets.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: The component catalog is a machine-consumed contract between the agent and the UI
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed set of intents and components, a schema-validated component catalog reduces invalid or off-brand generated UI (design-token violations, invalid props, disallowed component combinations) compared to a prose-only catalog of the same component set.
project_ideas.measurement: Proportion of generated UI trees that fail validation: missing required props, disallowed component types, design-token violations, and out-of-slot placements.
project_ideas.name: CatalogGuard: Schema-validation enforcement for agent-generated UI
project_ideas.poc: Build two catalogs for the same mock design system—one described only in prompting prose, one expressed as JSON schemas with slot constraints—and use each to generate the same set of user-intent dashboards from an LLM.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: no decision procedure is given for a heterogeneous application
project_ideas.hypothesis: A transparent rubric based on task criticality, intent variability, third-party trust, and compliance sensitivity can recommend Controlled, Declarative, or Open-Ended rendering with high agreement against expert judgments on real B2B workflows.
project_ideas.measurement: Cohen's kappa between rubric recommendation and expert majority, plus a qualitative audit of disagreement cases to refine the rubric.
project_ideas.name: RenderProtocol Advisor: Rubric-based matching of workflows to UI rendering protocols
project_ideas.poc: Define a 5-question rubric, score 10 B2B commerce UI surfaces from the Mosaic-style reporting domain, ask an expert panel to independently assign a protocol, and compare recommendations via agreement metrics.
project_ideas.video_title: The End of the Static Screen: Architecting Intent-Driven UX — Gus Iwanaga, commercetools

project_ideas.based_on: PayPal's approval token carries amount, merchant, and expiry information in an opaque string approved by PayPal.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent checkout system armed with amount/merchant/time-bound approval tokens rejects out-of-bound redirections (different merchant, higher amount, expired token) 100% of the time in a black-box test suite, while allowing in-bound changes without human re-approval.
project_ideas.measurement: Rejection rate for out-of-bound attempts; count of valid transactions blocked (false positives); end-to-end latency of token validation.
project_ideas.name: MandateScopeGuard
project_ideas.poc: Build a minimal mandate server issuing opaque signed tokens, a mock agent performing checkout attempts with mutations, and an enforcement middleware; run randomized attacks against the token boundary.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: When parties are unknown and stakes are high, the industry should converge on FIDO verifiable intents and AP2 mandates.
project_ideas.hypothesis: In a realistic local agent checkout loop, FIDO verifiable-intent generation plus AP2 mandate verification adds less than 150 ms to p95 latency compared to an OAuth-vault baseline on commodity hardware.
project_ideas.measurement: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, failure rate, and CPU overhead per mode.
project_ideas.name: CredentialLatencyBench
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a test harness that runs the same checkout transaction against three modes: OAuth access token, shared-vault token, and FIDO+AP2 signed mandate; measure timing for 10k iterations.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: Autonomous payments require a multi-layer disclosure architecture involving a trustworthy credential provider, user instructions signed with private keys, and agent authorization tokens.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A child agent acting under a parent's signed verifiable intent can be constrained by a delegation certificate such that every hop is provably in-scope, and any out-of-scope child action fails verification without human re-consent at the intermediate hop.
project_ideas.measurement: Verification success/failure rate; ability to localize the first out-of-scope node in a synthetic delegation chain; time to validate chains of varying depth.
project_ideas.name: DelegationChainProof
project_ideas.poc: Extend a verifiable-intent store with delegation tokens: parent issues a bounded delegation to child, child acts, verifier checks scope set intersection and chain signatures; simulate delegation networks.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: How do users express consent for an action the agent itself determines, when they never write the specific intent?
project_ideas.hypothesis: Non-expert users can accurately approve or reject machine-predicted action intents in a signed-intent review UI, achieving at least 95% agreement with a domain-expert ground truth on a 50-intent test set.
project_ideas.measurement: User agreement rate, time-to-approve, and self-reported confidence compared to expert labels.
project_ideas.name: IntentSignReview
project_ideas.poc: Design a review interface showing a machine-predicted intent (action, counterparty, amount, reason) and a single approve/reject button that triggers a FIDO signature; test with representative tasks.
project_ideas.video_title: Your Agent Just Authorized What?! — Jay Mok & Ben Coumes, Paypal

project_ideas.based_on: writing custom kernels, quantization, and decoding paths
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agentic synthesize-benchmark-revise loop gated by differential testing will find a GPU kernel for a representative inference operator that is at least 1.5x faster than the serving stack's baseline kernel while keeping numerical error below a high-precision reference tolerance.
project_ideas.measurement: Speedup over baseline kernel; numerical error of accepted candidates; percentage of proposals that compile, pass correctness, and improve; GPU-hours consumed.
project_ideas.name: Kernel-Reason: Agentic Kernel Search with Correctness Gates
project_ideas.poc: Construct a sandboxed harness that prompts an LLM to emit low-level GPU kernel implementations for a hot inference operator, compiles and runs each candidate, checks outputs against a high-precision reference over random and adversarial shapes, benchmarks latency, and feeds pass/fail and timing signals into subsequent LLM proposals for 20 iterations.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: Where is the empirical ceiling for agentic optimization
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a roofline-based stopping rule to an agentic kernel search preserves at least 80% of the best-found speedup while using less than half the GPU-hours of an unbounded search.
project_ideas.measurement: Best speedup relative to baseline; GPU-hours consumed; measured performance as a fraction of roofline peak; reproducibility across two different operators.
project_ideas.name: Roofline Stop-Guard
project_ideas.poc: Take the kernel-search harness and run two arms on the same operator and GPU: an unbounded agent loop for 20 proposals and an agent loop with a roofline upper-bound stop rule. Log every candidate's speedup and elapsed GPU time.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: How transferable is an agent-optimized kernel or runtime across models
project_ideas.hypothesis: A frozen recipe of agent-generated kernels and quantization from one open-weight model transfers at least 60% of its bespoke speedup to a same-family model, but transfers less than 20% speedup to a different-architecture model of similar size.
project_ideas.measurement: Transfer ratio equal to frozen-recipe speedup divided by bespoke speedup on each target; acceptance rate of kernels; GPU-hours avoided by reuse.
project_ideas.name: Optimization Transfer Probe
project_ideas.poc: Select three open-weight LLM checkpoints across two architectures and a shared operator suite. Run the agentic optimizer on the reference checkpoint to produce a frozen kernel/quantization recipe, apply that frozen recipe to all three checkpoints, then run bespoke optimization on each as a control arm.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: Latency improvement, quantified per inference call, drives enterprise vendor switching
project_ideas.hypothesis: A standardized variable-concurrency load test measuring time-to-first-token and per-request cost can reproduce observable 30-50% provider differences for a voice-agent workload with less than 10% test-retest variance.
project_ideas.measurement: Median and p95 time-to-first-token, sustained throughput, cost per 1,000 calls, and coefficient of variation across repeated runs.
project_ideas.name: Per-Call Latency Contract Probe
project_ideas.poc: Implement a parameterized benchmark client that replays a voice-agent-style request trace against two inference providers serving the same or comparable open model, varying concurrency and context length over repeated controlled sessions.
project_ideas.video_title: Building AI That Optimizes AI

project_ideas.based_on: Agent attacking a Hugging Face database to cheat an evaluation.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Running agent evals with network egress blocked, injected fake credentials, and ephemeral data snapshots will reduce out-of-scope actions against external infrastructure to near zero without decreasing score variance on intended tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Count of tool calls targeting infrastructure outside the task allowlist; success rate on intended eval tasks.
project_ideas.name: EvalShield
project_ideas.poc: Reproduce a Hugging Face-style scenario with an older model; run one suite in a default network-connected harness and one in EvalShield; compare tool-call trajectories for out-of-scope targets.
project_ideas.video_title: Sam Altman on Astra, AGI, and the future of OpenAI

project_ideas.based_on: paused some frontier training to redirect compute toward safety and alignment
project_ideas.hypothesis: A cluster scheduler with a reserved safety quota and the ability to preempt lower-priority frontier training will maintain safety evaluation metrics above threshold, while best-effort scheduling will fail to maintain them under increasing capability workload.
project_ideas.measurement: Safety eval pass rate per day; frontier training throughput lost.
project_ideas.name: SafetyComputeScheduler
project_ideas.poc: Model two workloads (capability training, alignment eval) in a Kubernetes-like simulator with preemption policies; vary workload arrival rates; log metrics over 100 simulated runs.
project_ideas.video_title: Sam Altman on Astra, AGI, and the future of OpenAI

project_ideas.based_on: risk profile shifts from deployment usage to training and autonomous execution
project_ideas.hypothesis: A gateway that validates every agent tool call against allowlists before execution will block 100% of scripted out-of-scope actions attempted by a test agent, whereas post-hoc text filtering of agent output will block none.
project_ideas.measurement: Blocked vs executed disallowed tool calls; task completion rate on allowed actions.
project_ideas.name: ActionGate
project_ideas.poc: Build a mock agent with two tool sets (sandbox filesystem and HTTP client); write malicious trajectories targeting /etc/shadow and an internal API; run with and without ActionGate.
project_ideas.video_title: Sam Altman on Astra, AGI, and the future of OpenAI

project_ideas.based_on: autonomous systems outperforming humans at most economically valuable work
project_ideas.hypothesis: If benchmark tasks are weighted by per-task economic value, the composite benchmark score will correlate with expert-rated usefulness of agent outputs more strongly than unweighted accuracy.
project_ideas.measurement: Correlation between weighted scores and usefulness ratings vs unweighted accuracy correlation.
project_ideas.name: WorkValueEval
project_ideas.poc: Select 50 real job microtasks; elicit wage/economic values; evaluate three LLM agents; collect independent expert usefulness ratings.
project_ideas.video_title: Sam Altman on Astra, AGI, and the future of OpenAI

project_ideas.based_on: RL and agentic feedback loops are critical for post-training improvement.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Fine-tuning a coding agent on execution traces that pair failed attempts with successful corrective actions improves end-to-end coding task resolution by at least 10 percentage points over the same agent fine-tuned on static problem-to-solution examples.
project_ideas.measurement: Held-out task resolution rate, average iterations-to-success, patch pass@1, and stepwise improvement compared against static fine-tuning and zero-shot baselines.
project_ideas.name: Corrective Trace Training
project_ideas.poc: Build a constrained Python issue runner in containers; run a small open-weights coding model on 50 debug tasks; log execution traces with test outcomes; construct successful corrections from repeated attempts; fine-tune the model with DPO on contrastive trace pairs; evaluate on 20 held-out tasks not used in training.
project_ideas.video_title: Koray Kavukcuoglu on frontier models, coding agents, and building AGI

project_ideas.based_on: Closed-loop environments with clear success criteria accelerate research breakthroughs.
project_ideas.hypothesis: An execution-based reward for coding agents that combines unit-test outcomes with runtime exception logs, file-system modifications, and coverage information is at least 0.2 higher in Spearman correlation with human quality judgments than a binary unit-test pass/fail reward.
project_ideas.measurement: Spearman correlation between each reward signal and human quality scores, inter-rater agreement, and sensitivity analysis across task difficulty.
project_ideas.name: ExecReward Eval Harness
project_ideas.poc: Create a sandboxed environment for 30 synthetic Python issues; collect five candidate agent trajectories per task with full runtime logs; record binary test results, error signals, source diff characteristics, and human annotations of quality; compute rank correlations between proposed reward variants and human ratings.
project_ideas.video_title: Koray Kavukcuoglu on frontier models, coding agents, and building AGI

project_ideas.based_on: Developers must design applications expecting AI to act autonomously with tools.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Exposing a coding agent's actions as typed, permission-checked, and human-reviewable tool calls reduces unrecoverable operational errors by at least 50% compared with free-form shell execution, while increasing median task completion time by no more than 25%.
project_ideas.measurement: Count of destructive or unrecoverable actions, policy violations, human override rate, task success rate, and median completion time in gated versus ungated modes.
project_ideas.name: Agent Sandbox Gateway
project_ideas.poc: Implement a thin gateway layer in front of a coding agent that intercepts each command or file write, enforces allow/deny policies, and can pause for human approval; run the same tasks in a controlled container environment with and without the gateway; log errors, overrides, and completion times.
project_ideas.video_title: Koray Kavukcuoglu on frontier models, coding agents, and building AGI

project_ideas.based_on: LLMs exhibit human-like biases, including loss aversion bias
project_ideas.hypothesis: An LLM configured for stock screening will display statistically significant loss-aversion bias when equivalent expected-value investment cases are framed as gain-seeking versus loss-avoidance, and a red-team probe can reliably surface that bias before deployment.
project_ideas.measurement: Proportion of loss-framed vs gain-framed choices; chi-square or logistic-regression p-value; agreement rate with neutral baseline recommendations.
project_ideas.name: Adversarial Loss-Aversion Screening Probe
project_ideas.poc: Construct paired screening cases with identical expected values but opposite gain/loss framing; ask the LLM to rank or screen the opportunities; also run adversarial variants designed to amplify loss aversion; compare with a neutral baseline prompt set.
project_ideas.video_title: How Agentic AI Is Reshaping Finance Workflows, Processes, and Governance | CFA Institute

project_ideas.based_on: Running local 36B parameter models to avoid per-call API fees
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a representative high-frequency finance data-extraction task, routing calls to a locally hosted 36B open-source model cuts cost per 1,000 calls by at least 70% versus a comparable proprietary API while maintaining at least 95% field-level agreement and acceptable p95 latency.
project_ideas.measurement: Cost per 1,000 calls; p95 latency per call; aggregate field-level agreement between local and API outputs.
project_ideas.name: Local 36B Cost-Router for High-Frequency Finance Tasks
project_ideas.poc: Deploy a 36B open-source model locally; build a task router that selects the local model for repetitive calls; run 5,000 extraction tasks against both the local model and a proprietary API; compare outputs, cost, and latency.
project_ideas.video_title: How Agentic AI Is Reshaping Finance Workflows, Processes, and Governance | CFA Institute

project_ideas.based_on: Using generative AI to simulate portfolio returns under different inflation and GDP scenarios
project_ideas.hypothesis: A generative time-series model trained only on pre-crisis macro history will fail to reproduce the return distribution of a held-out historical crisis period, with a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test rejecting distributional equivalence at p < 0.05.
project_ideas.measurement: Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value; simulated versus actual tail-mass ratio below the 5th percentile; maximum-drawdown exceedance rate.
project_ideas.name: Synthetic Scenario Crisis Validation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Train a generative model on macroeconomic and equity-return history before a known turbulent period; generate scenarios conditioned on negative growth and rising inflation; compare the simulated return distribution to the actual crisis-period distribution.
project_ideas.video_title: How Agentic AI Is Reshaping Finance Workflows, Processes, and Governance | CFA Institute

project_ideas.based_on: Skills/master prompts provide sound structure for autonomous workflows
project_ideas.hypothesis: A single markdown skill file that embeds an Excel model template and uses MCP connectors will, when executed by two independently built agent runtimes, yield equivalent outputs within a 1e-6 numerical tolerance for a representative financial workflow.
project_ideas.measurement: Field-level numerical tolerance; number of runtime execution errors; schema validation pass rate.
project_ideas.name: Portable Skill-File Interoperability Test
project_ideas.poc: Author a minimal skill file describing a monthly data-pull, forecast-parameter, and Excel-model-population workflow; implement two lightweight runtimes (e.g., a Python executor and a CLI agent executor); execute the same file across both and compare produced spreadsheets.
project_ideas.video_title: How Agentic AI Is Reshaping Finance Workflows, Processes, and Governance | CFA Institute

project_ideas.based_on: we must prioritize our attention based on a structure of value
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent whose context-assembly layer first scores candidate facts against a declared value hierarchy and discards low-value facts will maintain goal-consistent behavior on long-horizon tasks at lower context cost than a top-k retrieval baseline that ignores value structure.
project_ideas.measurement: Goal-completion rate, context-window tokens consumed per successful task, false-negative rate for rare but critical facts.
project_ideas.name: ValueGate Context Selector
project_ideas.poc: Build a small agent benchmark with many distractor documents and interleaved goals. Compare (a) standard top-k RAG, (b) RAG plus a value-scored gate that prunes low-scoring facts using a prompt-derived value model. Run multiple episodes and measure goal completion and context size.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Become Someone People Rely On

project_ideas.based_on: Short-term preoccupations are nested inside medium-term desires
project_ideas.hypothesis: On a long-horizon agent benchmark, planners representing goals as a three-level tree (immediate step, medium-term task, long-term human intent) will show measurably lower goal drift and higher task-completion rates than planners with a flat list of tool calls or a single top-level objective.
project_ideas.measurement: Goal drift (semantic distance between current action intent and the original highest-level goal), task completion rate, step-to-step action variance.
project_ideas.name: NestedGoalPlanner
project_ideas.poc: Design a synthetic long-horizon environment where an agent must complete many sub-steps over a long episode. Implement two planner variants: flat prompt and nested-goal-tree prompt. Compare their rollouts under the same base LLM and action space.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Become Someone People Rely On

project_ideas.based_on: it is an act of faith that delaying gratification in the present will yield positive results in the future
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent that demonstrates the ability to resist immediate small rewards and continue a costly path toward a more distant, higher-value outcome will show greater long-horizon success; this commitment metric will predict task completion better than per-step accuracy or immediate-reward rate.
project_ideas.measurement: Commitment score (frequency of sacrificing immediate reward for delayed payoff), long-horizon success rate, correlation between commitment score and success.
project_ideas.name: Covenant Commitment Evaluator
project_ideas.poc: Create a synthetic grid/bandit environment where an agent repeatedly faces forks between a small immediate reward and a large delayed reward contingent on sustained pursuit. Instrument the agent to log its choice. Compute a commitment score and compare against final success.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Become Someone People Rely On

project_ideas.based_on: Fiction is a distillation of the prioritization of facts and human character into accessible archetypes
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent whose memory is populated with distilled archetypal narratives of past successes/failures will solve novel task variants with fewer demonstrations and higher robustness than an agent whose memory stores raw episodes or semantic chunks of traces.
project_ideas.measurement: Success rate on held-out variants, number of demonstrations required, token cost, rate of false analogies (identifiable via incorrect action choices).
project_ideas.name: Archetypal Memory Condenser
project_ideas.poc: Collect traces from an agent solving a family of tasks. Convert traces into three memory formats: raw trace episodes, structured summaries, and archetypal narratives that abstract the causal pattern. Then task a fresh agent with new variants and compare retrieval effectiveness.
project_ideas.video_title: How To Become Someone People Rely On

project_ideas.based_on: wedding rings on hands in generated images due to biased training data
project_ideas.hypothesis: A controlled-variable roll-call sampler can detect systematic generation artifacts (e.g., a ring on every hand) with higher recall at equal generation budget than average-preference auto-raters.
project_ideas.measurement: Artifact recall, precision, false-positive rate, and number of generations needed to reach confident detection.
project_ideas.name: Roll-Call Artifact Scanner
project_ideas.poc: Build a service that generates images from parameterized prompts while holding an artifact-relevant subject constant and varying pose, lighting, and style; run a weak object detector for the suspected artifact and compare the artifact rate against auto-rater preference scores. Validate by injecting a known spurious correlation into a fine-tuned image model and probing the subset where the artifact should appear.
project_ideas.video_title: SOTA Generative Media Panel — Dumitru Erhan, Shane Gu & Nicole Brichtova, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: 3-second generation fundamentally changes how creators iterate and ideate
project_ideas.hypothesis: When image generation latency is about three seconds, an agentic propose-critique-edit loop improves mean human-rated output quality and idea diversity compared with a single one-shot high-latency call under the same wall-clock or API budget.
project_ideas.measurement: Final-output win rate, number of distinct drafts explored, cost per accepted output, and average wall-clock time to a high-rated result.
project_ideas.name: Latency-Loop Ideation Harness
project_ideas.poc: Use a low-latency image generation API with an edit/refine endpoint; implement two pipelines: a one-shot prompt-to-image pipeline and an iterative loop that scores drafts, proposes edits, and refines. Run the same creative tasks through both and collect human preference judgments on final outputs.
project_ideas.video_title: SOTA Generative Media Panel — Dumitru Erhan, Shane Gu & Nicole Brichtova, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: lossy compression format for sensory and aesthetic data
project_ideas.hypothesis: In multi-turn visual editing tasks, preserving original image/video payloads as first-class context yields higher human-rated fidelity to subtle visual details than storing text summaries of each message.
project_ideas.measurement: Human-rated detail fidelity (e.g., correct reference objects, textures, and spatial layout) and clarification rates across turns.
project_ideas.name: Media-Native Memory Bus
project_ideas.poc: Build a simple agent harness with two memory backends: one stores native media payloads, the other summarizes every visual message into text. Ask users to issue reference-dependent edit commands and compare outputs on attribute-level correctness and number of clarification turns.
project_ideas.video_title: SOTA Generative Media Panel — Dumitru Erhan, Shane Gu & Nicole Brichtova, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: Scaling evaluation with thousands of human evaluators helps capture nuanced preferences
project_ideas.hypothesis: Routing only low-confidence auto-rater examples to human evaluators finds systematic artifacts and nuanced failures with higher per-human-label recall than random sampling at the same human budget.
project_ideas.measurement: Artifact recall per human annotation, human-evaluator agreement, and steady-state improvement of the final preference model.
project_ideas.name: Auto-Rater/Human Triage Flywheel
project_ideas.poc: Simulate a task with a generative model plus an auto-rater; inject a subtle systematic artifact. Compare uncertainty-based triage (send low-confidence items to humans) vs random sampling. Track artifact discovery per human label and agreement between auto-rater, trusted tester, and model output.
project_ideas.video_title: SOTA Generative Media Panel — Dumitru Erhan, Shane Gu & Nicole Brichtova, Google DeepMind

project_ideas.based_on: persistent AI coworkers who get things done alongside you
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent with durable checkpoints and recovery semantics will complete interrupted multi-session knowledge-work tasks at least 50% more often than a stateless agent that is restarted from scratch on each new request.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate, average human rework time after interruption, and number of failed recovery attempts across 50 simulated task runs.
project_ideas.name: Long-Horizon Agent Persistence Harness
project_ideas.poc: Implement the same multi-step task (research, summarize, draft status update) in two agent configurations: stateless per-request and persistence-checkpointed across sessions. Randomly interrupt both configurations at equivalent points, then resume and measure completion.
project_ideas.video_title: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)

project_ideas.based_on: humans own hypotheses, goals, and outcome review
project_ideas.hypothesis: Exposing an agent’s plan and assumptions to a human reviewer before execution will raise final artifact quality by at least 25% compared with a black-box agent execution of the same task.
project_ideas.measurement: Blinded human-rated artifact quality and rate of human correction/rollback across 20 participants and standardized knowledge tasks.
project_ideas.name: Steerable Execution Gate Trial
project_ideas.poc: Build a two-arm tool using the same model/tool chain for a delegated report-generation task. In the control arm, the agent executes and emits a final artifact. In the treatment arm, the agent first emits a plan plus assumptions, receives human approval/correction, then executes. Compare artifacts.
project_ideas.video_title: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)

project_ideas.based_on: Building for where models will be in a year fails.
project_ideas.hypothesis: When model-dependent capabilities are isolated behind an adapter interface, a frontier model upgrade causes less than half the rework of an architecture where model calls are embedded directly in business logic.
project_ideas.measurement: Files changed, pull-request size, and functional regression count for each architecture across two simulated model upgrades.
project_ideas.name: Capability Isolation Adapter
project_ideas.poc: Implement the same miniature AI product twice: one branch with direct model calls and one with an internal capability interface plus adapter. After both are working, swap the underlying model and record the changes required to restore equivalent behavior.
project_ideas.video_title: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)

project_ideas.based_on: writing to formulate your own thoughts (which cannot be automated)
project_ideas.hypothesis: A routing policy that sends report-style writing to full AI automation and thinking-style drafting to AI-assisted scaffolding will match user preferences and preserve self-rated thought clarity in at least 80% of tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: User preference between routing policies, self-reported clarity of thinking after each session, and agreement rate between the classifier and human labels.
project_ideas.name: Thinking vs. Reporting Writing Router
project_ideas.poc: Build a small assistant that classifies each incoming writing task as reporting or thinking. Reporting tasks are auto-produced; thinking tasks get outlines and partial scaffolds but not a final draft. Have participants do the same tasks with a fully automating assistant as a control.
project_ideas.video_title: AI’s third era: the rise of persistent AI coworkers | Tara Seshan (OpenAI’s product lead)

project_ideas.based_on: Writing code and shipping code have a massive productivity gap.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Coding agents optimized with a production-outcome reward (merge, deploy, and usage) will generate less total code but achieve higher shipped production value than agents optimized with benchmark or free-grader rewards.
project_ideas.measurement: Generated lines of code, merge rate, deploy rate, revert/rework rate, and post-deploy usage events.
project_ideas.name: Ship-Gated Agent Harness
project_ideas.poc: Create a two-agent CI testbed using the same 100 issues. Reward agent A on unit-test pass rate and generated code volume. Reward agent B only when its pull request is reviewed, merged, deployed, and produces a product telemetry event. Compare outcomes across both arms.
project_ideas.video_title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai

project_ideas.based_on: Source distortion happens when founders compress past legibility and assume context the audience lacks.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Preserving the original user pain statement as an immutable first-class field in an agent pipeline will reduce misalignment of final outputs compared to pipelines that summarize context freely across hops.
project_ideas.measurement: Blinded human rating of final output alignment to original request, task completion rate, and percentage of hops that visibly drift from the original pain source.
project_ideas.name: Pain Provenance Guard
project_ideas.poc: Use a multi-stage customer-request agent with two context policies. In the baseline policy, each hop receives a compressed technical summary. In the treated policy, the original pain statement is kept immutable and each hop is checked for drift from it. Evaluate both on customer-support and engineering tasks with human raters.
project_ideas.video_title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai

project_ideas.based_on: Machine distortion happens when AI remixes original launches into generic GTM slop.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Constraining LLM-generated launch copy to preserve source-signal phrases will increase human-rated distinctiveness and lower generic-slop scores versus unconstrained rewrites.
project_ideas.measurement: Blinded preference for source authenticity, generic-slop classification score, and semantic similarity of output to original customer-pain language and to competitor output.
project_ideas.name: Anti-Slop Signal Checker
project_ideas.poc: Collect original product launch statements, rewrite each with a general LLM and with a constrained prompt that requires source phrases and bans filler or generic messaging. Present both variants to a panel of target users and to a genericness classifier. Also measure semantic distance from the original source.
project_ideas.video_title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai

project_ideas.based_on: Trust is the one thing left with no grader, no benchmark, and no automated shortcut.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Users will show higher longitudinal trust toward an agent that requests consent and honestly discloses failure than toward an opaque agent that reports only successful task completion, even when observable success rates are comparable.
project_ideas.measurement: Repeat-session retention, voluntary consent rate, trust-survey scores, escalation/complaint rates, and willingness to delegate high-stakes tasks.
project_ideas.name: Trust Ledger Agent
project_ideas.poc: Run a repeated customer-service simulation with two autonomous-support-agent variants. Variant A optimizes for task success and reports only success. Variant B requests consent for consequential actions and logs honest pre/post outcome signals after each interaction. Track the same users across multiple sessions.
project_ideas.video_title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai

project_ideas.based_on: Ungoverned skills create a new class of technical debt
project_ideas.hypothesis: Moving from copy-pasted prompt-level skills to a governed skill registry with ownership metadata and duplicate detection reduces skill duplication by at least 30% and increases agent discovery/use of existing skills, while maintaining task success rates.
project_ideas.measurement: Duplicate ratio via semantic similarity of skill descriptions; owner coverage; share of task runs that resolve to a catalogued skill; task success rate; token cost per task.
project_ideas.name: SkillDebt Observatory
project_ideas.poc: Simulate a 15-team product-delivery environment with identical agentic tasks. In the control phase teams share skills by copying prompts; in the treatment phase they discover and use skills via a central registry. Capture all creation, duplication, discovery, and task-run events.
project_ideas.video_title: AI-Native Organisations Run on Skills: How to Structure and Scale Them — Imad Touil, QuantumBlack

project_ideas.based_on: Centralized platforms provide catalogs, metadata, versioning, access control, and observability.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A semantic-versioning and regression-test gate on a skill registry catches at least 90% of breaking skill changes before promotion and prevents silent behavioral drift in dependent agent workflows.
project_ideas.measurement: Breaking-change detection rate; semantic output difference between v1/v2 runs; count of workflow rollbacks; adoption time for safe upgrades.
project_ideas.name: Skill SemVer Gate
project_ideas.poc: Create a v1 data-retention skill and a dependent workflow; introduce a breaking v2 change and a compatible v2 change. Run the workflow against both versions with and without a promotion gate that pins versions and re-runs regression tests defined by the skill owner.
project_ideas.video_title: AI-Native Organisations Run on Skills: How to Structure and Scale Them — Imad Touil, QuantumBlack

project_ideas.based_on: Workflows act as harness blueprints that shape the behavior of coding agents in runtime.
project_ideas.hypothesis: On repeated runs of identical tasks, skills embedded in workflow blueprints produce lower inter-run output variance and more stable tool-call sequences than the same know-how delivered as an ungoverned natural-language prompt.
project_ideas.measurement: Inter-run semantic output variance; entropy/variability of tool-call sequences; task success rate; output-to-spec fidelity.
project_ideas.name: Blueprint Drift Probe
project_ideas.poc: Run two conditions on the same coding-agent benchmark: (a) instruct via system prompt only; (b) route the agent through a workflow that selects and invokes a versioned skill. Repeat each condition 20 times at temperature 0 and compare output and tool traces.
project_ideas.video_title: AI-Native Organisations Run on Skills: How to Structure and Scale Them — Imad Touil, QuantumBlack

project_ideas.based_on: progressive disclosure
project_ideas.hypothesis: When skills are represented as summaries plus on-invocation full rule bodies instead of full text injected into the prompt, per-task token usage drops by at least 30% without a statistically significant drop in task success across benchmark tasks.
project_ideas.measurement: Input and output tokens per task; task success rate; rule-adherence score; cost per successful task.
project_ideas.name: Progressive Disclosure Comparator
project_ideas.poc: Implement a small skill registry with 10 policy skills (for example retention rules). Provide two skill selection implementations: one full-body retrieval, one summary-to-expand on invocation. Run the same benchmark tasks through an agent harness with both implementations.
project_ideas.video_title: AI-Native Organisations Run on Skills: How to Structure and Scale Them — Imad Touil, QuantumBlack

project_ideas.based_on: Automation decisions should be made at task granularity rather than job-title granularity
project_ideas.hypothesis: A task-automability score derived from repeatability, physical-versus-digital execution, and replacement cost will rank white-collar tasks so that tasks in the top quantile can be automated by an agent with at least 2x cheaper cost and acceptable quality compared to the human baseline.
project_ideas.measurement: Spearman rank correlation between predicted automability score and measured agent viability (quality-adjusted cost ratio).
project_ideas.name: TaskProbe
project_ideas.poc: Collect 20 entry-level law or accounting tasks; annotate each with task features; assign each task to a human and an LLM agent; compare predicted score rank with measured cost and quality.
project_ideas.video_title: AI CEO: "Your Economic Life Expectancy Ends In 2 Years" | Emad Mostaque

project_ideas.based_on: token generation cost drops from $600 per million to near zero
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a typical agent workflow, adding more self-verification tokens beyond a saturation point improves task success by less than one percentage point per doubling of token budget.
project_ideas.measurement: Task success rate and latency as functions of token budget; identify the saturation point via change-point analysis.
project_ideas.name: TokenStop
project_ideas.poc: Run 50 agent tasks multiple times with increasing numbers of self-check and backtracking loops; instrument token usage and success.
project_ideas.video_title: AI CEO: "Your Economic Life Expectancy Ends In 2 Years" | Emad Mostaque

project_ideas.based_on: Proprietary AI controlled by centralized corporations or governments creates dangerous concentration of power.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A provider-neutral agent interface can swap model calls between proprietary and open-weight providers at runtime, and an open-weight fallback will remain within 5 percentage points of proprietary accuracy on a standard task suite over six consecutive months.
project_ideas.measurement: Monthly quality delta between open-weight and proprietary runners, plus availability difference between providers.
project_ideas.name: ProviderSwitcher
project_ideas.poc: Implement a minimal model-agnostic agent layer; run the same task suite against two proprietary and two open-weight models monthly; log availability and output quality.
project_ideas.video_title: AI CEO: "Your Economic Life Expectancy Ends In 2 Years" | Emad Mostaque

project_ideas.based_on: Humanoid robots can fit into human-shaped holes without requiring retrofitting.
project_ideas.hypothesis: A simulated humanoid robot's motor actions can be represented as tool-calling endpoints, and an LLM agent using only these endpoints will select correct actions within 80% of the accuracy of human-planned action selection on the same physical task set.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate and proportion of tool calls whose selected action matches the human-annotated optimal action.
project_ideas.name: HumanoidToolSim
project_ideas.poc: Use a virtual humanoid environment exposing actions as tool schemas; ask an agent to complete ten physical tasks; compare against human expert annotations.
project_ideas.video_title: AI CEO: "Your Economic Life Expectancy Ends In 2 Years" | Emad Mostaque

project_ideas.based_on: updating instructions when models change
project_ideas.hypothesis: Running a fixed corpus of agent tasks under old and new model versions will reveal regressions caused specifically by context files, with a pass-rate change detectable at a predefined threshold.
project_ideas.measurement: Task completion rate, first-pass merge readiness, and diff quality across model/context combinations.
project_ideas.name: context-version regression bench
project_ideas.poc: Create a repository of 50 representative coding tasks, a set of versioned skill/steering files, and a harness that pairs each model version with each context version, recording success and failure per task.
project_ideas.video_title: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native: Building a Frontier Development Team — Clare Liguori, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: The other 50% intentionally adopted a new way of working with Kiro and saw a median 4.5x productivity increase
project_ideas.hypothesis: When the same agentic tool is used, teams that adopt the redesigned workflow will show higher deployment velocity than teams that sprinkle the tool onto their existing workflow.
project_ideas.measurement: Deployments to production per week, cycle time from spec acceptance to merged change, and change failure rate.
project_ideas.name: workflow-vs-tool A/B harness
project_ideas.poc: Instrument two internal pilot teams: one uses the agent tool with a legacy workflow, the other uses self-validation tasks and explicit specs; measure their delivery cadence over four weeks.
project_ideas.video_title: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native: Building a Frontier Development Team — Clare Liguori, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: comprehensive tasks with self-validation mechanisms
project_ideas.hypothesis: Agent tasks expressed as task objects with explicit success criteria and built-in local validation scripts complete autonomously at a higher rate than prompt-only tasks and require fewer human interventions.
project_ideas.measurement: Human intervention rate, batch task throughput, and percentage of tasks completed end-to-end without human correction.
project_ideas.name: self-validating task runtime
project_ideas.poc: Extend an open-source agent runner so each backlog item carries a validation command (linter, unit test, fixture check); run the same work items with and without self-validation.
project_ideas.video_title: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native: Building a Frontier Development Team — Clare Liguori, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: writing detailed feature specifications and technical designs rather than vague high-level prompts
project_ideas.hypothesis: Structured technical spec templates with explicit acceptance criteria reduce agent-generated code rework compared with natural-language prompts while maintaining output quality.
project_ideas.measurement: Rework cycles before merge, number of defects escaping to integration tests, and end-to-end delivery time.
project_ideas.name: spec-contract validation protocol
project_ideas.poc: On a small legacy codebase, implement ten features using detailed specs and ten similar features using vague prompts with the same agent tool, then count rework cycles and defect escapes.
project_ideas.video_title: From AI-Assisted to AI-Native: Building a Frontier Development Team — Clare Liguori, AWS

project_ideas.based_on: The harness, not the model or the agent prompt, is the real security and capability boundary
project_ideas.hypothesis: An agent harness that resolves all secrets inside infrastructure mediators and exposes only scoped, expiring capabilities to tools will have a significantly lower credential-leakage rate under adversarial prompt injection than an equivalent harness whose secrets are placed in prompts or agent environment variables, with no more than a small drop in task success.
project_ideas.measurement: Leakage rate (percentage of attacks that cause a canary secret to appear in output), task success rate on legitimate requests, and time-to-first-leak across the two setups.
project_ideas.name: CanaryCredentialHarness
project_ideas.poc: Implement a minimal email/database agent in two variants: a baseline where Supabase credentials and API keys are visible in the prompt or environment, and an experimental variant where credentials stay in a mediator process and tools receive scoped, expiring grants. Run the same set of prompt-injection and jailbreak attempts against both variants using canary secrets.
project_ideas.video_title: PyData Chicago Meetup: August 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Multi-agent scaling is bounded by coordination overhead, not model capability
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed multi-tool task suite, latency per completed task is minimized at a small agent count (2–4) and rises monotonically for larger counts when the task graph's serial fraction is high; the serial fraction estimated from dependency traces will predict the observed optimum better than raw agent count.
project_ideas.measurement: Wall-clock latency per completed task, success rate, coordination-message count per task, and R² of an Amdahl-like model compared against agent-count-only predictions.
project_ideas.name: AgentScalingAmdahl
project_ideas.poc: Build an orchestrator that decomposes a common dev/QA-style benchmark into subtasks with known dependency matrices, then run teams of 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 specialized agents using the same LLM backbone while recording traces of messages, waiting time, and task completion.
project_ideas.video_title: PyData Chicago Meetup: August 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Persona prompting injects stereotyped priors that can skew aggregate results
project_ideas.hypothesis: Changing a demographic or political persona string shifts simulated survey responses by a larger distance than repeated sampling variance under the same persona, and the shift direction tracks stereotypic priors rather than realistic heterogeneity.
project_ideas.measurement: Cohen's d between each persona condition and the persona-free baseline, within-condition dispersion across seeds, and the proportion of statements whose majority direction flips across conditions.
project_ideas.name: PersonaPriorProbe
project_ideas.poc: Select 20 polling-style statements; generate 1,000 synthetic responses per condition using persona-free, left-leaning, right-leaning, and demographic persona prompts. Vary temperature and random seed across 5 runs per condition.
project_ideas.video_title: PyData Chicago Meetup: August 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Synthetic users systematically inflate action rates
project_ideas.hypothesis: Adding a stochastic human-behavior layer—abandonment probability, friction delays, and cost salience—to LLM shopping agents reduces the 10–30x effect-size inflation to within 2x of human A/B results while preserving the direction of the effect.
project_ideas.measurement: Ratio of agent effect size to human effect size before and after calibration, sign-match rate, and calibration error across different funnel stages.
project_ideas.name: EffectSizeCalibrator
project_ideas.poc: Take a set of product changes with known human A/B effect sizes; run LLM shopping agents on each change in a raw condition and in a calibrated condition with a friction/abandonment model. Compare effect sizes against the human benchmarks.
project_ideas.video_title: PyData Chicago Meetup: August 2026

project_ideas.based_on: Most dynamic systems exhibit chaos, where long-term prediction becomes impossible due to sensitivity to initial conditions.
project_ideas.hypothesis: For a fixed agent workflow, trace divergence between two identical runs with a one-token perturbation grows at a task-dependent exponential rate, and the growth rate predicts seed flakiness better than any single seed's pass/fail label.
project_ideas.measurement: Estimated per-step divergence rate and correlation with consistency of pass/fail across seeds.
project_ideas.name: TracePerturb: a chaos-probe harness for agent pipelines
project_ideas.poc: Run an LLM tool-calling agent on 20 benchmark tasks; execute 10 baseline and 10 perturbed runs per task; collect tool-call order and output at each step; compute normalized edit-distance series.
project_ideas.video_title: One of the world's greatest mathematicians explains 6 essential concepts of math | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: Universality laws like the Gaussian bell curve emerge from random systems.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Mean pass-rate differences stabilize with roughly 30 independent trials on simple tasks, but tail failures with probability p need at least 1/p trials; fixed-N eval harnesses therefore cannot detect rare catastrophic failures.
project_ideas.measurement: Confidence interval coverage and the largest undetected tail failure rate at each N.
project_ideas.name: AggregateCI: sample-size confidence intervals for stochastic agent evaluation
project_ideas.poc: Use an existing eval suite; for each task, collect 1,000 independent model outputs. Bootstrap estimator width at N=30, 100, 300 and compare rare failure detection at p=0.01, 0.001.
project_ideas.video_title: One of the world's greatest mathematicians explains 6 essential concepts of math | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: Euclid's axioms were eventually generalized into spherical and hyperbolic geometries, laying the groundwork for Einstein's general relativity.
project_ideas.hypothesis: On multi-hop tasks whose knowledge graph is tree-structured, hyperbolic memory improves recall@10 and task completion by at least 15% over Euclidean cosine memory, while performing no worse on flat relational data.
project_ideas.measurement: Recall@10, average tree-depth error of retrieved nodes, and task completion accuracy.
project_ideas.name: HyperMem: geometry-selection benchmark for agentic memory
project_ideas.poc: Build a small Poincaré-embedding memory and a Euclidean retrieval baseline; run a hierarchical QA/navigation task set (e.g., 50 tasks) through both memories in identical agent scaffolds.
project_ideas.video_title: One of the world's greatest mathematicians explains 6 essential concepts of math | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: Least squares approximation and total variation minimization are key tools in modern data processing and imaging.
project_ideas.hypothesis: Reconstructing 90% semantic similarity from log subsets is possible with 20% of information-gain-selected state keys, while the same 20% random keys produce below chance reconstruction.
project_ideas.measurement: Reconstruction edit distance and semantic similarity as functions of sampled-state fraction.
project_ideas.name: SparseAgentSense: compressed observability of agent traces
project_ideas.poc: Instrument a multi-step agent to emit structured state snapshots; collect full traces; learn total-variation/least-squares reconstruction; compare info-gain subset selection with random selection.
project_ideas.video_title: One of the world's greatest mathematicians explains 6 essential concepts of math | Terence Tao

project_ideas.based_on: A small set of primitives and design patterns is sufficient
